libs.note: BH-7598 (slice C0): a person completes a 2FA step of a web-task run. wh_request_human asks harness-jobs (POST /api/web-task/human/ask), sends one Telegram message (bin/lib/web-human/telegram.sh) and one NEEDS-HUMAN: comment (bin/lib/web-human/board.sh), then polls. The wait, the poll interval, the answer TTL and the board logins are settings rows the worker reads (web_task.human_*); these two are the box-side HTTP timeouts. Applied by the lib through lib_env_apply web-human when the caller has loaded bin/lib/lane-gate.sh. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-23-BH-7598-web-task-human.md.

knobs.note: The whole-request timeout of each worker call and each Telegram send of wh_request_human (curl -m). Read as ${WEB_HUMAN_TIMEOUT_S:-15}.
The connect timeout of the same calls (curl --connect-timeout). Read as ${WEB_HUMAN_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S:-5}.
